description_en: Queries whether a specified virtual border router (VBR) instance is associated with a Smart Access Gateway instance in a specified region
description_zh: 查询指定边界路由器（VBR）实例是否在指定地域下绑定有智能接入网关实例
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-sag-vbr-relations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-instance-ids '["vbr-bp15ihkk93ezxppk****"]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSagVbrRelations

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the regions supported by Smart Access Gateway and their corresponding region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the virtual border router (VBR) instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
边界路由器实例所属地域ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: vbr_region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of the virtual border routers (VBRs) used for routing. You can query multiple VBR instance IDs at a time. The maximum value of N is 20
parameters.help_zh: 边界路由器实例ID。可以一次查询多个边界路由器实例，N取值最大为20
parameters.name: vbr_instance_ids

SagInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the Smart Access Gateway

SagUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the Smart Access Gateway instance belongs
SagUid.description_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID

VbrInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the virtual border router (VBR) used for routing
